items.title: Featured video: Changing the conversation about endometriosis
items.summary: Documentary shines a powerful light on a painful disease that affects 265 million women, highlights efforts at MIT’s Center for Gynepathology Research to study the disease and find treatments.

items.title: Powering up for a pivotal moment
items.summary: From a nuclear revival to qubits, the MIT Energy Initiative’s annual research conference tracked deployment of today’s technologies to discovery of tomorrow’s breakthroughs.

items.title: A flexible new route to designer materials built from nanoparticles
items.summary: Pliable connector molecules could be key to creating nanoparticle-based materials for photonics, chemical catalysis, medicine, and more.

items.title: MIT engineers design a safer, more efficient vaccination system for farmed fish
items.summary: Water-resistant microneedles made from food-grade silk could deliver vaccines to help prevent the spread of disease in aquaculture.

items.title: Study pinpoints states with steepest warming trends since 1980
items.summary: The findings indicate where adaptive measures are needed most around the United States.

items.title: Q&A: Hey AI, who should I vote for this year?
items.summary: MIT professors Adam Berinsky and Chara Podimata discuss a new project to track how AI chatbots are responding to questions about the 2026 U.S. midterm elections.

items.title: MIT engineers create nanoparticles for delivering personalized cancer vaccines
items.summary: The particles carry a customized dose of cancer antigens that can provoke a strong immune response against tumors.

items.title: Magnetic sensors track muscle movement, for better prosthetic limb control
items.summary: Researchers hope to use these sensors to help people with amputation achieve more natural movements with their prosthetic limbs.

items.title: New system gives users more control over their online experience
items.summary: The Social.Wiki framework enables anyone to easily edit social websites within the system, while allowing them to choose the content they see.

items.title: Capturing the complete process of embryonic development
items.summary: By tracking over 1 million cells, researchers created a detailed map of embryonic development in mice. It could provide development and disease insights.
